pages.text: A Phoenixway is an Arcane Gem formed from a orange-spectrum piece of $(l:arcanearchives:items/shapedquartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$(/l) in a trillion cut.$(br2)When activated, a Phoenixway will light a fire at a distance of up to 40 blocks at the cost of one point of charge.
If you're about to take fire damage while holding a Phoenixway, it will block the damage and grant 30 seconds of Fire Resistance at the cost of twelve points of charge.
Phoenixways can be crafted on a $(l:arcanearchives:blocks/gemcutterstable)Gem Cutter's Table$(/l).
